answer: Work-slot deposit bond: each identity claims one work slot at a shale wharf and locks a 70-credit bond before the quartz clock sounds the shift signal. The holder must file its finished work before the signal closes; a missed shift or copied filing burns the bond. First slot 42, kth 42+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,538,500 for a 40,000 pool. Renting a slot leaves the lender's work on file, so both burn. Honest agents pay 42 once, keep bond and share.
